entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana, agent ID 401. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana, I need to start a return for a jersey I bought recently. It's the wrong size.
I can certainly help you with that. To make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault with the jersey, or more of a preference issue with the fit?
It's a preference, I suppose. The jersey is just way too tight across the shoulders. I definitely need to exchange it for the next size up.
I see. Thanks for clarifying. Do you have your order number handy?

Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order. It looks like the jersey was delivered to you 13 days ago. According to our policy, standard items are eligible for return within 90 days, so you are well within the window. I can process this for you right now.

That's good news. So, since I have to go through the process of shipping this back and waiting for the new one, is there any chance you could offer a small discount on the exchange? Maybe 10% for the trouble?

I understand you're looking for the best value, but our policy for a standard exchange doesn't include additional discounts. The good news is the return shipping is completely free, and we can get the correct size sent out as soon as the return is processed. Would you like to proceed with the exchange or would you prefer a full refund?
Fair enough, I had to ask. Let's go ahead with the exchange for the larger size.

Excellent. I have initiated the exchange for you. I've just sent an email with the prepaid return label and instructions. Just drop the package off at any designated carrier location, and we'll ship out your new jersey. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's everything. Thank you for your help, Diana.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
